name: warp-session-restore
description: Restart your Claude Code sessions in Warp after a reboot: a hook snapshots every running Claude Code CLI session (folder, name, launch flags) on each session start and turn end; restore reopens each one in a Warp tab, grouped by folder (its git repository, worktrees included), resuming it in place. In the running Warp's window, or as a launch configuration that starts Warp with one tab group per folder. macOS and Linux.
